user.title: Set up a Smarther thermostat
user.description: The MQTT bridge is a one-time prerequisite. [First-time setup guide](https://github.com/alescim17/smarther/blob/main/docs/FIRST_TIME_SETUP.md). Enter only the name and device topic prefix; never paste vendor credentials here. Setup does not send thermostat commands.

data_description.topic_prefix: Prefix ending before /device_state. Do not include the /device_state or /set suffix.

error.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the Home Assistant MQTT integration first.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a valid, exact MQTT prefix without + or #.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT topic prefix is already configured.

init.title: Control policy
init.description: Leave disabled until the remote bridge and any other command writers have been checked. Commands require recent non-retained telemetry.
